rows.label: sodium bicarbonate
rows.hook: fizzes up a science-fair volcano and helps cakes rise in the oven

rows.label: acetic acid
rows.hook: gives pickles and salad dressing their sour tang

rows.label: sodium chloride
rows.hook: is sprinkled on fries and spread on icy roads in winter

rows.label: acetone
rows.hook: is a fast-evaporating solvent used to strip lacquer from fingertips

rows.label: sodium carbonate
rows.hook: is added to laundry to soften hard water and boost cleaning power

rows.label: sucrose
rows.description: disaccharide made of glucose and fructose
rows.hook: sweetens coffee and is the main ingredient in most candy

rows.label: calcium carbonate
rows.hook: is used to write on blackboards and makes up seashells and limestone

rows.label: sodium hypochlorite
rows.hook: whitens laundry and disinfects swimming pools

rows.label: ethylene glycol
rows.description: organic compound used in the making of polyester fibers and in antifreeze formulations
rows.hook: keeps car radiators from freezing and is sweet-tasting but toxic

rows.label: magnesium sulfate
rows.hook: is dissolved in a bath to soothe sore muscles

rows.label: propane
rows.description: chemical compound, commonly used as a fuel
rows.hook: fills the tanks that fuel grills and camp stoves

rows.label: naphthalene
rows.hook: keeps clothes-eating insects out of stored sweaters with a strong smell
